renaud-coulomb--minesparis.name: Renaud Coulomb
renaud-coulomb--minesparis.title: Professor of Economics
renaud-coulomb--minesparis.notes: Homepage: 'Professor of Economics, Ecole des Mines Paris - PSL University, CEDP, i3 CNRS'; also Honorary Senior Fellow, University of Melbourne and Affiliate Professor, Ecole Polytechnique. MINES Paris is a grande ecole within PSL, not a classic university; kept as faculty since rank is Professor. Unit expansion 'Centre for Industrial Economics' is my expansion of CERNA and should be checked. Paper in RESTUD 93(1) pp. 404-437.
